# Hajati (حاجاتي)

> Hajati is a Sudanese on-demand delivery app. Instead of ordering from a fixed
> catalogue, customers write what they want in their own words, and nearby
> captains compete to quote a price and deliver it.

The service operates in Sudan, starting from Kassala. The app is available for
Android and iOS, and the interface is in Arabic. Captains (delivery riders) apply
through this website rather than in the app.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://hajati.app/): What Hajati is, how ordering works, the Magic Box, and links to download the app.
- [Captain guide](https://hajati.app/captain-guide): How delivery captains earn, what is required of them, and how the application process works.
- [Captain application](https://hajati.app/captain-application): The form used to apply as a delivery captain, including identity document upload.
- [Delete account](https://hajati.app/delete-account): How a customer or captain can request deletion of their account and data.

## Policies

- [Terms and conditions](https://hajati.app/policies/terms-and-conditions): الشروط والأحكام — the agreement governing use of the service.
- [Privacy policy](https://hajati.app/policies/privacy-policy): سياسة الخصوصية — what data is collected and how it is handled.
- [Cancellation policy](https://hajati.app/policies/cancellation-policy): سياسة الإلغاء — when an order may be cancelled and by whom.
- [Content policy](https://hajati.app/policies/content-policy): سياسة المحتوى — what may and may not be requested through the app.
- [Consumer protection](https://hajati.app/policies/consumer-protection): سياسة حماية المستهلك — customer rights and complaint handling.
- [Anti-fraud policy](https://hajati.app/policies/anti-fraud-policy): سياسة مكافحة الاحتيال — how fraud and abuse are handled.
- [Captains agreement](https://hajati.app/policies/captains-agreement): اتفاقية كباتن التوصيل — the terms delivery captains operate under.

- [Contact](mailto:contact@hajati.app): Email for support, partnerships and press.
